description: This is a Ruby script for testing Redis's LRU eviction policy by simulating key insertions, access patterns, and generating an HTML report with visualizations of key states.

methods.name: testit
methods.description: Performs Redis eviction testing by inserting, accessing, and evicting keys, then generates an HTML report.

methods.name: print_avg
methods.description: Calculates and prints the average error rate over multiple test runs.
